purpose: One/Zero interpretations bound to Step 1 v4 cash-basis boundary controls and the Tax Year 2024 wage floor.
source_basis: Georgia JTC Step 1 Avg Wages and Hours Narrative
Georgia JTC Step 1 Avg Wages and Hours Diagram
GA JTC One Zero Methodology Overview.xlsx (SHA-256 C2F8CF527AF8423F88105D3EE77B30F938D7CFCE4E5D532A6C851F60701D310A)

OZ-01.decision: Generate twelve One/Zero month targets from the approved Reference fiscal window, August 2023 through July 2024; malformed workbook cutoff cells are not expected values.
OZ-01.falsified_by: John's Access run uses another matrix window.

OZ-02.decision: Min-Max coverage uses earliest included PPS through latest included PPE per employee, unit, and FEIN; assign 1 when Min PPS <= monthly cutoff <= Max PPE. Boundary completeness is inherited from Step 1 v4 and remains review-visible.
OZ-02.falsified_by: John's Access matrix uses paycheck dates or another range.

OZ-03.decision: Pay Period coverage uses PPS <= month target <= PPE. Equality-to-paycheck-date wording remains treated as a source defect.

OZ-04.decision: For Month 12, when last PPE is in Month 12 and day > 15, use that PPE as target; otherwise use month end.
OZ-04.falsified_by: A later John-authored flow supersedes this rule.

OZ-05.decision: Pay Period One/Zero uses reviewed company cycle groups or practitioner-identified material payroll dates. The participation heuristic is diagnostic only.
OZ-05.falsified_by: John supplies a deterministic classifier validated against Access.

OZ-06.decision: No employee may contribute more than one count in a month. Flag every overlap; the reproducible provisional disposition is not sign-off authority.
OZ-06.falsified_by: John supplies an authoritative allocation rule or reviewed dispositions.

OZ-07.decision: For this full-year benchmark, divide unit total by 12 and preserve unrounded, source-nearest-whole, and application two-decimal views.
OZ-07.falsified_by: John uses another denominator or rounding sequence.

OZ-08.decision: Eligibility remains customer-wide; One/Zero grain includes employee, unit, and FEIN.
OZ-08.falsified_by: Access uses another entity allocation grain.

OZ-09.decision: Min-Max emits employee-unit-FEIN spans. Pay Period collapses employee-unit-FEIN-PPS-PPE rows before reviewed major-period selection.

change_control.supersession_rule: Create a new version when Access or stakeholder evidence resolves an ambiguity; retain v4 with every run that used it.
